title: xDrip not receiving IOB data from Nightscout
body:
Good morning. Till now I could see IOB and pump data in the Extra Line of xDrip, but suddendly it has dissapeared. xDrip (last nightly build, October the 1st) receives treatments (bolus and carbs) from Nightscout but not basal (there is no blue line on top). I haven't changed anything for a long time (at least in xdrip; I upgraded to AAPS 2.7 a couple of days ago). I've even installed a variant just with my heroku address and it's the same. I've no idea what can happen, any help is welcome.
Thank you in advance

Edit: maybe it's and AAPS issue, I've Local Broadcast enabled in AAPS so data should be received from Nightscout or AAPS...

comments.body: What version of xDrip did you use before? Does it work again, if you downgrade to that version?

Hello. It seems to be related with the AAPS update, I've asked in their github page and I'm not the only one with this issue.
Thank you so much
Regards
@JimZam Please can you link the correlating AAPS issue, here?
